description: This file is a TypeScript source code that imports modules, defines functions, and contains logic to convert Todoist project data into a board and block structure for export, including handling project columns, cards, and descriptions.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Interface representing a section within a project, with id and name.

classes.name: Todoist
classes.description: Interface representing the overall Todoist data structure, including projects, sections, notes, and items.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments, reads input file, converts projects to boards and blocks, and writes output.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a Todoist project into a board and associated blocks.

methods.name: getProjectColumns
methods.description: Retrieves columns (sections) for a project, defaulting if none are found.

methods.name: getProjectCards
methods.description: Filters items belonging to a specific project.

methods.name: getCardDescription
methods.description: Generates description text for a card, including attachments.
